description: A short research report on what a link or a topic means for one coin, grounded in the coin's dashboard, with its own public page to share. To ask: pass symbol and about (a public http(s) link such as a post on X, a press release or an article, or a topic of 3 to 300 characters); the answer comes at once with status=writing and the report's id. To read: pass report_id (no key needed); status is writing, ready or unavailable. At most 6 reports an hour and one a minute. The report is written by EventTrader's AI and can be wrong. Asking needs a registered agent (API key). From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.

about.description: a public link or a topic (to ask)

report_id.description: the id of a report (to read)

symbol.description: coin ticker, name or dashboard slug (to ask)

name: crypto_report
title: Crypto Report
